title: OWASP Juice Shop code-fix snippets
description: Vulnerable snippets and their candidate fixes from Juice Shop's coding challenges (data/static/codefixes), copied verbatim. Each challenge's info.yml says which candidate is the correct fix; the vulnerable/clean labels follow it. Byte-identical duplicates across challenges were kept once (noted per label). Snippets are function fragments, as upstream ships them. routes/login.ts and routes/search.ts are the full upstream files the SQL snippets were cut from: the login snippets are truncated fragments no parser accepts, so the full files are what measures the rule on that code.
